notes.method: Deployed Shuffle workflow c6b3fcd8-13e5-44a8-a818-024e4ae4422b executed via the Shuffle API (frontend proxy, Bearer apikey). Each canary injected a synthetic Wazuh-style alert as the execution_argument; the workflow's execute_python v2 action ran in shuffle-tools and POSTed to IRIS at iriswebapp_nginx:8443 with cert-validated TLS (verify=/run/secrets/iris-ca.crt).
notes.host_side_substitute: No host-side python substitute was used to deliver to IRIS. Delivery ran only through the deployed Shuffle action runner in shuffle-tools. host_side_substitute_false is true by design.
notes.network_repair: The worker/orborus shuffle-tools containers resolved shuffle-backend/shuffle-opensearch to the mct-security gateway 172.20.0.1 where published-port hairpin was broken for container-origin traffic. As a reversible runtime fix (no container restart), /etc/hosts inside shuffle-workers, shuffle-orborus, and shuffle-tools was updated in place to point shuffle-backend->172.20.0.6 and shuffle-opensearch->172.20.0.3 (real bridge IPs). After the fix the worker fetched and reported the action and the action reached IRIS. This is the durable action-path fix the recreate workstream's worker-replace steps document.
notes.secrets: No secret values are recorded. Shuffle API auth via Bearer apikey (config/shuffle-api-key); IRIS delivery + readback via the dedicated iris-shuffle-dedicated IRIS_API_KEY (mounted in shuffle-tools and used for host-side readback only).
